eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of India.
2. The applicant must have a differently-abled certificate.
3. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized university or college.
4. The applicant must have secured admission in a higher education (undergraduate/postgraduate) course.

5. The differently-abled students pursuing professional, technical, diploma and certificate, PG, graduation courses in institutions recognized by the University Grants Commission/All India Council for Technical Education/Medical Council of India/Rehabilitation Council of India or any other appropriate regulatory body of the Government of India are eligible to apply.
6. The applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship/stipend.
7. The age limit for the applicant is 18-35 years.
8. The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed ₹2.50 lakh from all sources.
9. The applicant must have passed the previous qualifying examination with at least 50% marks.
10. The applicant must have a minimum of 40% disability.

scheme_name: Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People
eligibility: The applicant should be a Native of Puducherry.
The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
The applicant should not possess a house.
The applicant should be from Scheduled Caste or from Other Economically Backward Class.
For Scheduled Caste
The applicant should not have a house site of an area of 450 sq.ft. to build the house.
The annual income of the applicant should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-.
For Other Economically Backward Class
The applicant should not have a house site granted by Adi Dravidar Welfare Department.

scheme_name: Pre Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribe Students
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student studying in Class IX or Class Xth.
2. The applicant must be from Scheduled Tribes.
3. The total annual income of parents/guardians of the applicant from all sources must not exceed ₹ 2.50 lakh per annum.
4. The applicant must not be availing of any other scholarship by the govt.

scheme_name: NSAP - Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India.
2. The applicant must be living Below Poverty Line.
3. The applicant must be at least 60 years of age.
